reviews.message: We wanted to escape the hustle and bustle of the city for a few days, and the location of this cottage immediately caught our attention. You can see that the hosts have thought of every detail so you don't miss anything. The bed is very comfortable and spacious enough for two people, and the whole atmosphere is welcoming and relaxing. The hosts were kind, friendly, and attentive, contributing to a truly enjoyable experience. We had a very good time throughout the three days we spent here and left completely relaxed. I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants a few days of peace in the middle of nature. We will definitely come back whenever we feel the need for a getaway away from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.

And what can I say about the accommodation? It's a break from it all, a return to nature. The land is beautiful, the accommodation is charming, and the animals greet us when we arrive. In short, I totally recommend staying at Dragos' place, whether for the hosting, the accommodation, or the activities to do!

reviews.name: Mel
reviews.message: A unique stay in tranquil surroundings. The treehouse was a perfect hideaway for a couple of days unwinding in nature. Our hosts were extremely welcoming, making us feel completely at home and proactively went out of their way to make our stay a pleasant one. The space itself is incredibly unique, although as expected quite small (just one room for bedroom, bathroom & kitchen without much personal space) so well suited for couples that "know each other well" and we would recommend keeping luggage to a minimum! We found it an incredible place and would absolutely love to go back and stay again.

reviews.message: Me and my wife stayed here for two nights. We chose this place while searching for a cozy and private escape from metropolitan areas. The hosts went above and beyond to make sure everything was to our liking and we received all the information we needed. Access to the location is straight-forward. Plenty of things to do in the area. We are already planning to return in the future, hopefully staying for a longer period!

And a very special mention to the adorable, sweet dogs who were with us the whole time — they made the stay even more special and heartwarming. Congratulations on creating something so beautiful. This is truly a place to remember, and I cannot recommend it enough.❤️❤️❤️

The house was clean, well heated, and equipped with everything needed for a comfortable stay, including with a child. The host was attentive and made sure everything was in order. The approximately 1-kilometer (0.6-mile) unpaved road is accessible and manageable if you drive carefully, even with a lower-riding car. Parking in the yard is very convenient. Overall, a perfect place for relaxation, fresh air, and quality time. I highly recommend it!

Overall, it’s a cute place, but with a few considerations depending on your preferences.

reviews.message: The electricity was unstable, the lights were blinking all the time, it was hurting our eyes, also we were afraid to charge our laptops. The host was nice, the dogs were amazing even tho they stole our food at night. I never left a bad review on this app, but I feel this one is necessary. Response from Dragos November 2023 At the moment you parked the car, even before seeing the house your group started with a very bad attitude, that the location is not as you expected (without doing a little bit of research on the location and surroundings) I even offered to give a full refund if you wish not to stay to our place. We didn't hear any complains from you during the stay. Feedback such as rotten pillars are unfortunately untrue. Those pillars (which are nost structural pillars, are recovered from an old house, they are not rotten, but aged, and they were intentionally placed there to give a particular feeling. Also burning on the toilet is a bad joke. That pipe is designed to heat the toilet space and it goes maximum to 60 degree (the heat is electronically controlled), nobody (not even families with small kids) ever had any issue with it in hundred of stays that we had. Also you wanted a place in the woods but are surprised when you left the food outside over night that it disappeared. There are foxes in the woods, other small mammals, cats, and also our dogs. Also if there was problems with the light we could have replaced them in minutes if you would have mention it. It is important to note that you have only bad reviews on Airbnb also and we somehow expected problems. Usuals people are saying that the place is much more better than in the photos because the photos are made by us as amateurs with just our phones. This was indeed our lowest review since 4 years on Airbnb but fortunately our Airbnb are enjoining the experience, are understanding what we offer when they book a place and they don't come arguing even from the moment they parked the car. So I am sure you can go on and on with bad reviews because this was your attitude from the moment your group came.. We are note a hotel, we are an experience accommodation, a family business and the place was build to bring you closer to the nature, give you a special feeling which we are glad that we can provide to most of our quests who come to us open minded.

Both beds are elevated up a small set of stairs and mattresses are on the floor. This may be a concern if you have mobility issues. I found the beds to be quite firm. The outdoor space is wonderful. As other reviewers mentioned, it is not standalone property with privacy. This property is on a residential street with other rentals and full time residents near by. Neighbors have dogs who serve as excellent guard dogs and cats that visit the property frequently. Overall, this was a memorable stay. I’d recommended it for anyone as an alternate to camping!

reviews.name: Medeea
reviews.message: Sejurul nostru la Bricks & Joy a fost superb, ne-am relaxat si delectat cu o priveliste de vis. Copilul nostru a fost foarte incantat de locul de joaca. Gazdele au fost dragute si prompte in comunicare. Recomandam!

reviews.name: Andrei
reviews.message: Totul minunat! Cu siguranta vom mai reveni si la celelalte casute! Am stat 2 adulti si doi copii si a fost spatiul suficient.

reviews.name: Nicoleta
reviews.message: Experiență bună!

reviews.name: Anamaria
reviews.message: Casuta Lego a fost o experienta frumoasa. Locul este unul placut si linistit. Locul de joaca este cireasa de pe tort, extraordinar pentru copii. Ai la dispozitie tot ce e nevoie pentru a te simti acasa, totul curat si ingrijit. Este locul in care ne-ar face placere sa ne intoarcem oricand.

reviews.name: Jugariu
reviews.message: Este extraordinar pentru familii cu copii. Casa este facuta la propriu din piese Lego

reviews.name: Rocío
reviews.message: Am petrecut câteva zile la cabana lui Lego. Mi-a plăcut șederea și zona pentru copii. Ceea ce mi-a plăcut cel mai mult a fost că, având casa chitară în față, fiul meu putea să-și facă prieteni și să se joace în timp ce noi pregăteam cina. Patul este imens și foarte confortabil. Îl recomand.

reviews.name: Gabriela
reviews.message: Totul a fost minunat, locul de joacă este superb, la fel si căsuța. Copilașii au avut ocupație și s-au simțit foarte bine, la fel și noi ❤️

reviews.name: Hee Jin
reviews.message: Îmi place pentru că mă pot bucura din plin de natură și de stelele de pe cerul serii.

reviews.name: Bara
reviews.message: Curat, liniștit și perfect pentru familii. Priveliștea este foarte frumoasă, iar fiicei mele i-a plăcut foarte mult zona de joacă pentru copii. Cu siguranță vom sta din nou aici!

reviews.name: Vasile
reviews.message: Casuta este mult mai interesanta in persoana, se vede ca a fost facuta cu pasiune, a fost curata, ingrijita si utilata cu tot ce am avut nevoie.

reviews.name: Natalia
reviews.message: Locatie exceptionala, casute inedite, instructiuni clare, recomandari f bune. Am mers cu un copil de aproape 4 ani si s a jucat in locul de joaca, care a fost surprinzator de bine dotat.

reviews.name: Laurentiu
reviews.message: Cu siguranță un mic colț de rai în inima Brașovului, aproape de multe obiective turistice de interes. A fost foarte curat, bine gândit, cu totul unic iar pentru o familie cu doi copilași mici, parcul din curte a fost atracția cazării! Un alt plus a fost designul făcut cu mult efort și pasiune: o căsuță lego! Felicitări pentru inițiativă și conceptul unic.

reviews.name: Lavinia
reviews.message: Un loc in care timpul se dilata, poziționarea, liniștea, confortul, faptul ca este aproape de punctele de interes ale zonei, toate au facut ca 2 zile sa se simtă ca si cum am petrecut o vacanta lunga. Un refugiu minunat dupa zilele pline de activități cu copilul, iar locul de joaca are posibilitati de joaca pentru copiii de toate vârstele.

reviews.name: Sorin
reviews.message: O locuință foarte frumoasă, cu tematică Lego. Este grozav pentru copii, dar am fost un cuplu fără copii și tot ne-am simțit bine. Terasa exterioară a fost foarte frumoasă. Au fost o mulțime de pisici drăguțe care au venit să ne viziteze afară.

reviews.name: Sorina
reviews.message: Mi-a plăcut locul, împrejurimile frumoase, iar gazdele au fost foarte drăguțe. Recomand cu căldură!

reviews.name: Gina
reviews.message: O locație inedită care ne -a surprins plăcut din toate punctele de vedere, tematica, spatiu și mobilier, locație, locul de joaca, totul perfect

Bricks and Joy is designed to offer you and your family a truly one-of-a-kind stay. Experience the charm of a tiny house on wheels, the panoramic view of a mountain cabin, and the comfort of a spacious bungalow with hot water, heating, WiFi, and electricity. The centerpiece is a massive 220x200 bed—perfect for the whole family. This is a unique house in the world, crafted from small plastic bricks and decorated with delightful plastic brick creations. The space Bricks and Joy Tiny House sits on a private property at the edge of a peaceful little spinney, surrounded by nature and beautiful mountain views. You’ll have your own parking space and plenty of outdoor room to relax, unwind, and enjoy the scenery. Perfect for up to 2 adults and 2 children, this 18 sqm tiny house combines coziness and comfort with all the essentials for a refreshing nature escape. The spacious terrace is fully equipped with a barbecue, dining table, and a cozy lounge area — perfect for slow mornings with coffee or relaxing evenings under the stars. Experience a house that 'lives' with nature! Because this unique home is crafted from thousands of interlocking bricks, you may hear soft settling sounds as the sun warms the walls—a magical reminder that you are staying in a truly one-of-a-kind architectural marvel. You’ll also enjoy a private garden of about 400 m². Traveling with another family? Book our neighbor property, the 'Guitar House,' to have the entire resort to yourselves! Perfect for two families who want to be close but have private spaces. Guest access Located near Râșnov, 6 km from the city, our location offers the best combination of nature, mountain views, and easy access to countless tourist attractions: Bran Castle, Râșnov Citadel, Bucegi mountain trails and cabins, Râșnov cave, Poiana Brașov Ski Resort, Zărnești Bear Sanctuary, and many more.
